event_description: Anaya Kapoor loses her eyesight at the age of 19 following an accident.
A photograph is taken showing Rishabh Malhotra, Anaya Kapoor, Dr. Nisha Verma and an unidentified man standing together.

timestamp: approx. 18 months and 3 days before Day 1 [approximate]
event_description: Aarav Mehra publicly humiliates the Puppeteer by predicting his next move. The Puppeteer disappears after promising to take away everything that makes Aarav human.
Three days after the confrontation, Aarav finds his wife Lavanya and daughter Tara murdered. The Puppeteer is never caught.
Anaya Kapoor begins receiving anonymous letters.

timestamp: years before Day 1; start date unknown [undetermined]
event_description: The psychological experiment connecting Aarav's family murder to the current murders begins. Its start date and the order of its events relative to the other pre-Day-1 events are not established.

timestamp: before Rishabh's death; exact time unknown [undetermined]
event_description: Rishabh writes an unsent message in his drafts: "I know what happened to Tara. He wasn't alone that night."
The Project Echo document on Rishabh's computer is accessed for the last time.

timestamp: Day 1, evening; order relative to the death unknown [undetermined]
event_description: Dr. Nisha Verma visits Rishabh at his apartment. The purpose and duration of the visit are not established.

timestamp: Day 1, evening; order relative to the death unknown [undetermined]
event_description: Three people enter the apartment floor, as recorded by building cameras. One person's face is not captured. Their identities are not established.
Rishabh Malhotra dies of poisoning in his study. One of two coffee cups at the scene contains traces of the poison.
Rishabh's damaged wristwatch stops at 9:17 PM. The actual time it stopped is not established.

timestamp: Day 1, after the death; discovery time unknown [undetermined]
event_description: Rishabh is found seated in his study facing an empty chair, with a chessboard between the chairs, a white piece in his right hand, the black king missing, two coffee cups present, and a note with the number 03 on the table.

timestamp: Day 1, after the discovery; exact time unknown [undetermined]
event_description: Aarav recognises the handwriting on the note as that of the killer who murdered his family.
The Puppeteer's message to Aarav is delivered: three people, three days, three mistakes.

timestamp: Day 1 to Day 4; removal date not fixed [approximate]
event_description: Aarav's department conducts a psychological fitness review and considers removing him from active duty within four days.
